== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was baptised at Torryburn, Fife, on 15 Oct 1689. The parish register names his father as [[Glasgow-4176|James Glasgow]] and his mother as [[Mitchell-58830|Jean Mitchell]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, his birth is placed before that date, and Torryburn is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

== Research Notes ==
The baptism is the only record found for John Glasgow. A search of live WikiTree profiles found no compatible match; [[Glasgow-1077|John]] belongs to a different family and is not this person.

The named parent–child relationships concern the people in this one baptism entry. No record of James or Jean’s own parents, or John’s later life, has been identified. The before-1670 parent dates are estimates from an assumed adult generation, not ages stated in the baptism. The transcript remains to be checked against the original register.
